description.short_caption: Graph of SARS cases by date of hospitalization in Singapore, February 25 to March 22, 2003.
description.detailed_description: This is a bar graph displaying the number of SARS cases in Singapore by date of hospitalization between February 25 and March 22, 2003. The x-axis represents the date of onset, while the y-axis shows the number of cases. The bars are color-coded to represent different transmission categories: index (blue), primary (yellow), secondary (pink), and tertiary (red). A notable annotation highlights a case-patient transit event on March 17. The graph provides a visual representation of the outbreak's progression and transmission dynamics.
visible_findings: Bar graph with dates on the x-axis and case counts on the y-axis.
Color-coded bars indicating transmission categories: index, primary, secondary, tertiary.
Annotation marking a case-patient transit event on March 17.

description.short_caption: Fluorescent microscopy showing cording morphology of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in culture.
description.detailed_description: This image depicts a fluorescent microscopy view of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in culture. The organisms exhibit characteristic cording morphology, with long, intertwined filamentous structures. The fluorescence highlights the bacterial structures against a dark background, aiding visualization. This morphology is typical of M. tuberculosis in liquid media cultures.
